title: Multi-Faceted Multimodal Monosemanticity
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on developing and using interpretability tools to analyze and disentangle features in visual-language models based on modality (vision, language, or cross-modal).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of its analysis.
